channel.title: Enduring
channel.description: Enduring tells the stories hiding behind the things that last. Every episode takes a name you might recognize, a famous product or a quietly unstoppable business, and digs into the real company behind it. The fires survived, the near-death moments, the families who kept the doors open for a hundred years. This channel is for entertainment and curiosity only.

item.title: EP03: LOWA
item.description: A century of Bavarian bootmaking: three cobbler brothers who each founded a famous boot company, a brass band that paid for the first machines, war and denazification, a near-collapse in the nineties, and the Italian deal that kept the doors open. This show is for entertainment and curiosity only.
item.itunes:author: Enduring

item.title: EP02: YKK
item.description: Ninety-two years, one founding family, and roughly half the zippers on Earth. The story of how a small Tokyo workshop beat the zipper's American inventors, built the machines that make the machines, and grew a business most people have never heard of. This show is for entertainment and curiosity only.
item.itunes:author: Enduring

item.title: EP01: Lodge Cast Iron
item.description: The 130-year-old Tennessee company behind America's most famous skillet: a teenage founder who walked 1,200 miles, the fire that burned it all down, the garden gnomes that saved the Great Depression, and the invention of pre-seasoned cast iron. This show is for entertainment and curiosity only, and nothing here is investment advice.
